title: Blacksmith - 5 million se 90 million CI jobs
content:
Is startup pe har hafte 5 million jobs chalte the. Ab NINETY million se zyada.
And the reason is AI writing code.
Company ka naam hai Blacksmith.
Co-founder aur CEO hain Aditya Jayaprakash.
Kal unhone announce kiya Series C, Sequoia Capital ke lead mein, one billion dollar valuation pe.
Premji Invest bhi is round mein hai, aur Peak XV, GV aur Y Combinator pehle se investors hain.
Total raised ab 125 million dollars hai.
Ab sawaal ye hai, ye company karti kya hai?
Blacksmith is a CI cloud.
CI matlab continuous integration.
Jab bhi koi code change hota hai, merge se pehle usko build aur test karna padta hai.
That step is CI. Boring lagta hai, but without it, broken code goes straight to your users.
Ab numbers dekho.
Company ke blog ke hisaab se, January se ab tak weekly CI jobs 5 million se badhkar 90 million se zyada ho gaye.
Aur unka ARR, yaani yearly recurring revenue, seventeen times badha hai.
These are company-reported numbers, but the direction is very clear.
Par ye ho kyun raha hai? Yahi asli kahani hai.
Blacksmith ne apne blog mein likha ki Anthropic ke CI jobs six months mein twenty five times badh gaye.
Kyunki ab Claude jaise agents bahut saara code likh rahe hain.
Code likhna ab slow part nahi raha.
The slow part is now checking whether that code can be trusted.
Toh aapke liye iska matlab kya hai?
Agar aap AI se code likhwate ho, toh tests likhna skip mat karo.
Har project mein ek simple CI pipeline lagao, jo har change pe tests chalaye.
AI can write a hundred lines in seconds. Your tests decide if those lines ship.
Mera take simple hai... jab sab log AI se code likh rahe hain, toh paisa un tools mein bhi hai jo us code ko check karte hain.
Gold rush mein shovel bechne wale bhi jeette hain.
